fields.name: X
fields.description: Crash coordinates in NZTM2000 (EPSG:2193, meters). Source for the derived longitude/latitude.

fields.name: Y
fields.description: Crash coordinates in NZTM2000 (EPSG:2193, meters). Source for the derived longitude/latitude.

fields.name: OBJECTID
fields.description: Unique crash record ID. Verified no duplicates (0 duplicate values).

fields.name: areaUnitID
fields.description: Stats NZ statistical area / meshblock identifiers for the crash location.

fields.name: crashLocation1
fields.description: Free-text road name(s) at the crash site — crashLocation1 is the primary road, crashLocation2 the intersecting road where relevant. High cardinality; likely too sparse/noisy to use directly as a categorical feature without grouping.

fields.name: crashLocation2
fields.description: Free-text road name(s) at the crash site — crashLocation1 is the primary road, crashLocation2 the intersecting road where relevant. High cardinality; likely too sparse/noisy to use directly as a categorical feature without grouping.

fields.name: crashSHDescription
fields.description: Whether the crash occurred on a State Highway.

fields.name: meshblockId
fields.description: Stats NZ statistical area / meshblock identifiers for the crash location.

fields.name: region
fields.description: NZ regional council area (e.g. "Auckland Region", "Otago Region").

fields.name: tlaId
fields.description: Territorial Local Authority (district/city council) ID and name.

fields.name: tlaName
fields.description: Territorial Local Authority (district/city council) ID and name.

fields.name: urban
fields.description: Urban vs. open-road classification of the crash location.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: WGS84 lon/lat, reprojected from X/Y via pyproj in clean_data.py.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: WGS84 lon/lat, reprojected from X/Y via pyproj in clean_data.py.

fields.name: crashFinancialYear
fields.description: NZ financial year (e.g. "2019/2020") the crash falls in.

fields.name: crashYear
fields.description: Calendar year of the crash (2006–2026 observed; 2026 is a partial year at the time of this dataset export).

fields.name: holiday
fields.description: Which public holiday period the crash occurred in, if any — non-null only for crashes actually inside one of those periods (94.5% missing is expected: most crashes aren't on a holiday).

fields.name: crashSeverity
fields.description: The original NZTA severity classification. Source of the derived binary target.

fields.name: fatalCount
fields.description: Number of deaths in the crash.

fields.name: minorInjuryCount
fields.description: Number of minor injuries.

fields.name: seriousInjuryCount
fields.description: Number of serious injuries.

fields.name: is_severe
fields.description: True if crashSeverity is Fatal or Serious. 6.72% True / 93.28% False — confirmed real class imbalance, not assumed. This is the ML target.

fields.name: crashDirectionDescription
fields.description: Compass direction associated with the crash — high missing % even after the Null-string fix, exact semantics (direction of travel? of impact?) not yet confirmed.

fields.name: directionRoleDescription
fields.description: A second direction-related field; relationship to crashDirectionDescription not yet confirmed.

fields.name: flatHill
fields.description: Terrain classification.

fields.name: light
fields.description: Light condition at crash time.

fields.name: NumberOfLanes
fields.description: Number of lanes at the crash site. IQR flags ~24% as "outliers" but this is an artifact of the value being mode-dominated at 2 — not a real data quality issue (see DECISIONS.md #7).

fields.name: roadCharacter
fields.description: Special road feature at the crash location; Nil presumably means no special feature.

fields.name: roadLane
fields.description: Lane/carriageway configuration.

fields.name: roadSurface
fields.description: Road surface type. Unsealed/End-of-seal show a materially higher severe rate than Sealed (12.9% / 15.6% vs. 6.6% — see PROJECT_PROGRESS.md).

fields.name: speedLimit
fields.description: Posted speed limit (km/h) at the crash location. Includes legitimate low values (2, 10 km/h) for carparks/shared zones.

fields.name: streetLight
fields.description: Whether street lighting was on. High missing % — likely only recorded for crashes in the dark, but not yet confirmed.

fields.name: temporarySpeedLimit
fields.description: Temporary speed limit (e.g. roadworks) — non-null only when one was in effect.

fields.name: trafficControl
fields.description: Traffic control device present at the crash location. Nil used as the is_uncontrolled_intersection flag basis.

fields.name: weatherA
fields.description: Primary weather condition at crash time.

fields.name: weatherB
fields.description: Secondary weather condition — only populated when a second condition applied, hence the high missing %.
